deferred_human_review_runtime: Library issue for @941design/nostr-events maintainers: the simple-pool transport de-duplicates by event id BEFORE signature verification, so a relay sending a forged event that reuses a genuine event id first gets the forgery rejected AND the genuine event dropped as a duplicate (message-suppression by a hostile relay). Found by app/tests/unit/marmot/client/transport.forgery.harness.test.ts. Not fixable in-app without a custom verifier (AC-TRANS-1 forbids one).

Pre-existing gap (not caused by this epic): call signaling signs inner kinds 25050-25055 with the account signer, but neither the old nor the new NIP-46 permission set requests them — calls may fail under permission-enforcing bunkers. AC-SIGN-3 fixes the app-added set to exactly {0,20602,30078,10050}; adding call kinds needs a spec change.
